I bought a 12 pack of white cheddar mac and cheese and Costco and by themselves, it's pretty meh. But this is what do to make it delicious.

Boil water, put the pasta in the water and add a few raw or frozen broccoli crowns to the water, they will cook in time, for 9 minutes.

drain the pasta/broccoli (or use whatever vegetables that you like)

once the pasta is strained add this:

-the cheese powder that came in the box

-a couple of tablespoons of milk

-a little butter

-a heaping scoop of sour cream

-dash of smoke paprika

-some black pepper

-a small dash of garlic powder

-add a protein if you have it ready to go, I just did this with cut up left over london broil that I had in the fridge.

mix well

add some shredded cheese on top, anything that you like

throw in the oven for about 10 minutes

super tasty mac and cheese out of the box!
